title: UK CPI — November 2026 consumer price inflation (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET), the last datum the December MPC sees, published ONE DAY before it votes
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationuknovember2026, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page is titled 'Consumer price inflation, UK: November 2026', reads 'Release date: 16 December 2026 7:00am', and states 'This release is not yet published'. Filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: and no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics — the same gap uk-cpi-2026-09-16, uk-cpi-2026-10-21 and uk-cpi-2026-11-18 were filed under. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of boe-decision-2026-12-17, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE boe-decision-2026-12-17 LANE, 2026-09-09. WHY IT EARNS A SLOT: it is the entire data run-in to the 2026-12-17 MPC vote. The committee gets this print at 07:00 London and announces at 12:00 London the NEXT DAY — a 29-hour window, tighter even than September's 48 hours and far tighter than November's, whose last two inputs (labour market 10-20, CPI 10-21) landed sixteen days out. A December MPC that changes its mind on data changes it on THIS print. Two things make the reading non-obvious, both of which the parent ledger carries. First, the headline is mechanically depressed: SI 2026/987 zero-rates GB domestic electricity from 2026-10-01, worth -0.098pp of CPI by ONS's own weights (electricity weight 20.6065/1000 x the 4.7619% VAT-inclusive fall of 5/105), and that notch is inside the index from the October data onward — so a soft November headline is a TAX CHANGE, not disinflation, exactly as uk-electricity-vat-zero-rate-2026-10-01 warns. Second, the number that actually moves the vote is SERVICES CPI, which ran 3.6% -> 3.4% into July and is the majority's stated disinflation premise; it carries no VAT distortion. Registered against as FT-boe-decision-2026-12-17-3. Tiered LOW to match the sibling UK CPI entries: symbols: [], no rates- or sterling-keyed house playbook, and this calendar's whole symbol universe is eight US mega-caps. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. The December UK LABOUR-MARKET release is deliberately NOT proposed alongside it — gov.uk's statistics-announcement search for the December-2026 window returned zero matching results on 2026-09-09, so no primary date exists to file.
